far_legs.cross_machine_check: the LFW control leg also ran on the Zenbook and printed identical summary lines
far_legs.outputs: docs/recognition-results/data/*.txt (aggregate distributions only; irbench emits no per-image data)
far_legs.runner: archhost (AMD Ryzen 7 5700G), irlume target/release build at b8313f4

frr_leg.anchors: each session includes a shipped-model control run; documented live floor for comparison: min 0.71 / mean 0.85
frr_leg.instrument: IRLUME_DEV=1 irlume calcapture --user <u> --det <yunet> --model <MODEL> --out <run>.jsonl --n 25 --tag <condition> (12-sample discarded warm-up first, so auto-exposure settles)
frr_leg.outputs: docs/recognition-results/data/floor-aggregates.json, derived by derive-floor-aggregates.py; raw jsonl holds biometric embeddings and is not committed
